hook: NYC's Last *12* Rooms to Light Up Indoors
dek: New York banned indoor smoking years ago, these 12 lounges are the exceptions.

slides.label: The Ban
slides.text: NYC banned indoor smoking years ago, so rooms where you can *still light a cigar indoors* are a short, special list.

slides.label: Manhattan
slides.text: Midtown's *Carnegie Club* has 20-foot ceilings, hand-carved bookcases and New York's longest-running *Sinatra show*.

slides.label: Brooklyn
slides.text: Fort Greene's *Diamante's* opened in 2009 as *Brooklyn's first cigar lounge*, owned by ring announcer David Diamante.

slides.label: Queens
slides.text: Rego Park's *Havana Dreams* has run since 2004, while *Harry's Habana Hut* in Bayside was voted Best Cigar Shop in Queens.

slides.label: The Bronx
slides.text: *Papa Juan Cigar Room* sits a short walk from *Yankee Stadium*, and *Moises Cigars* stays open to 2 AM every night.

slides.label: Staten Island
slides.text: Staten Island's *Cigar Vault Emporium* is the South Shore pick, with a lounge built for *like-minded people* to relax.

slides.label: House Rules
slides.text: Every lounge here is *21 and over*, ID required. Twelve rooms, *five boroughs*, one slow night still on the menu.

caption_linkedin:
New York banned indoor smoking in bars and restaurants years ago. What's left is a short, specific list, twelve cigar lounges across all five boroughs still built around a leather chair and a slow night.

Some are old Midtown institutions like the Carnegie Club, with a dress code, hand-carved bookcases and a live Sinatra show. Others are neighborhood businesses like Diamante's in Fort Greene, opened in 2009 and billed as Brooklyn's first cigar lounge, built by local operator and ring announcer David Diamante, who put his own Cuban-seed blend in the humidor next to the big brands.

The throughline worth noting: each lounge on this list survived a ban that closed plenty of rooms like it, by building a specific enough experience, dinner service, a game-day setup, a members' locker wall, that regulars kept showing up.

Which model holds up longer, the legacy club or the neighborhood lounge?
